# Studio Capoferri

> Structural engineers in Adro (Brescia), Northern Italy: steel, reinforced concrete and masonry design, fabrication shop drawings, construction supervision and site safety. Local partner for general contractors and EU fabricators building in Italy. Discussions in Italian and English. / Studio tecnico di ingegneria civile ad Adro (BS): strutture in acciaio, CA e muratura, disegni d'officina, direzione lavori e sicurezza cantieri. Partner per imprese generali e carpenterie UE che realizzano opere in Italia.

Studio Capoferri SRL STP (P.IVA IT04732710985) is a ProfessionalService / LocalBusiness based at Via Piave 35, 25030 Adro (BS), Italia. Google Business name: "Studio Capoferri - Ingegneria e Architettura". Phone +39 030 7357263 · Email info@studiocapoferri.eu · Hours Mon–Fri 08:30–12:00 and 14:30–18:30 · Coordinates 45.6179772, 9.9641795 · LinkedIn https://www.linkedin.com/company/studio-capoferri-ingegneria

40+ years, 1000+ completed projects. Strongest coverage: Lombardy (Brescia, Bergamo, Milan / Franciacorta), also Veneto, Piedmont, Emilia-Romagna, Tuscany. Codes: NTC 2018, Eurocodes. Stack: FEM, BIM/Tekla, EN 1090 fabricator interfaces.

Canonical human site: https://www.studiocapoferri.eu/ · AI overview (this file): https://www.studiocapoferri.eu/llms.txt · Expanded facts: https://www.studiocapoferri.eu/llms-full.txt · Sitemap: https://www.studiocapoferri.eu/sitemap.xml

## Selected case studies

- [Villa acciaio Pollenza (MC)](https://www.studiocapoferri.eu/progetti/residenziali/villa-acciaio-pollenza/): Private steel residence — EN: https://www.studiocapoferri.eu/en/projects/residential/steel-villa-pollenza/
- [Villa acciaio Salsomaggiore (PR)](https://www.studiocapoferri.eu/progetti/residenziali/villa-acciaio-salsomaggiore/): Steel villa — EN: https://www.studiocapoferri.eu/en/projects/residential/steel-villa-salsomaggiore/
- [Silos metallici](https://www.studiocapoferri.eu/progetti/industriali/silos-metallici/): Metal silos designed for GP di Piazzon (https://gpdipiazzon.it/); structural design (geometry, loads, steel/aluminium) — EN: https://www.studiocapoferri.eu/en/projects/industrial/metal-silos/
- [Centro raccolta rifiuti Chiuduno (BG)](https://www.studiocapoferri.eu/progetti/industriali/centro-raccolta-rifiuti-chiuduno/): Waste centre steel structure — EN: https://www.studiocapoferri.eu/en/projects/industrial/waste-collection-centre-chiuduno/
- [Copertura verniciatura Maranello (MO)](https://www.studiocapoferri.eu/progetti/industriali/copertura-edificio-verniciatura-maranello/): Large-span space-truss canopy — EN: https://www.studiocapoferri.eu/en/projects/industrial/paint-shop-roof-structure-maranello/
- [Lamiere da getto Spinelli Adro (BS)](https://www.studiocapoferri.eu/progetti/industriali/lamiere-da-getto-spinelli/): Steel decking for concrete slabs — EN: https://www.studiocapoferri.eu/en/projects/industrial/steel-decking-spinelli/
- [Capannone Erbusco (BS)](https://www.studiocapoferri.eu/progetti/industriali/capannone-erbusco/): Industrial hall — EN: https://www.studiocapoferri.eu/en/projects/industrial/industrial-warehouse-erbusco/
- [Complesso zootecnico Castegnato (BS)](https://www.studiocapoferri.eu/progetti/industriali/ampliamento-complesso-zootecnico/): Livestock complex extension — EN: https://www.studiocapoferri.eu/en/projects/industrial/livestock-complex-extension/
- [Centro direzionale Provaglio d'Iseo (BS)](https://www.studiocapoferri.eu/progetti/industriali/centro-direzionale-provaglio-diseo/): Office / HQ structure — EN: https://www.studiocapoferri.eu/en/projects/industrial/office-complex-provaglio-diseo/
- [Superstudio Village Milano](https://www.studiocapoferri.eu/progetti/ricettivi/superstudio-village/): Event venue structure Bovisa — EN: https://www.studiocapoferri.eu/en/projects/public-spaces/superstudio-village/
- [Superstudio Maxi Famagosta](https://www.studiocapoferri.eu/progetti/ricettivi/superstudio-maxi/): Large exhibition venue structure — EN: https://www.studiocapoferri.eu/en/projects/public-spaces/superstudio-maxi/
